title: Pydantic AI: Context Window Hook
description: Hook-based observation of model requests: records instructions, messages, and tools for each request to the WINDOWS list.

steps.description: Complete common.py helper with model, hook, and context display.
Imports: os, Hooks, OpenAIChatModel, and OllamaProvider.
Global state: WINDOWS list stores tuples of instructions, messages, tools.
Hook: before_model_request decorator, extract messages, tools, instructions, append to WINDOWS.
Make_model: creates OllamaProvider with base_url and api_key from env, returns OpenAIChatModel.
Show_context function for printing the context window.
Request indexing: handles negative indices, prints request number.
Instructions: prints [instructions] with repr if present.
Messages: iterates through parts, prints part_kind and truncated content.
Tools: prints [tool offered] with name and description for each tool.
